sanskrit: abhyadravanta devāṃs te sahasrāṇi daśaiva ha tatas tair arditā devāḥ śaraṇaṃ vāsavaṃ yayuḥ
english: Ten thousand of them rushed upon the gods; and the gods, sorely afflicted by them, went for refuge to Vāsava.

sanskrit: sa ca tair vyathitaḥ śakro vasiṣṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau tato 'bhayaṃ dadau tebhyo vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
english: And Śakra too, harried by them, went for refuge to Vasiṣṭha; then the blessed sage Vasiṣṭha granted them safety.

sanskrit: tathā tān duḥkhitāñ jānann ānṛśaṃsyaparo muniḥ ayatnenādahat sarvān khalinaḥ svena tejasā
english: Perceiving them thus in distress, the sage, devoted to compassion, effortlessly burned up all the Khalins with his own radiant power.

sanskrit: kailāsaṃ prasthitāṃ cāpi nadīṃ gaṅgāṃ mahātapāḥ ānayat tat saro divyaṃ tayā bhinnaṃ ca tat saraḥ
english: And that great ascetic led the river Gaṅgā, which had set out toward Kailāsa, to that celestial lake, and by her the lake was cleft open.

sanskrit: saro bhinnaṃ tayā nadyā sarayūḥ sā tato 'bhavat hatāś ca khalino yatra sa deśaḥ khalino 'bhavat
english: The lake cleft by that river became the Sarayū; and the region where the Khalins were slain came to be known as Khalina.

sanskrit: evaṃ sendrā vasiṣṭhena rakṣitās tridivaukasaḥ brahmadattavarāś caiva hatā daityā mahātmanā
english: Thus were the dwellers of heaven, with Indra, protected by Vasiṣṭha; and the great-souled one slew the Daityas who had been granted a boon by Brahmā.

sanskrit: etat karma vasiṣṭhasya kathitaṃ te mayānagha bravīmy ahaṃ brūhi vā tvaṃ vasiṣṭhāt kṣatriyaṃ varam
english: This deed of Vasiṣṭha I have recounted to you, O sinless one. I say to you—or do you name to me a Kṣatriya superior to Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca ity uktas tv arjunas tūṣṇīm abhūd vāyus tam abravīt śṛṇu me haihayaśreṣṭha karmātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ
english: Bhīṣma said: Thus addressed, Arjuna fell silent, and the Wind said to him: Hear from me, O best of the Haihayas, the deed of the exceedingly great-souled Atri.

sanskrit: ghore tamasy ayudhyanta sahitā devadānavāḥ avidhyata śarais tatra svarbhānuḥ somabhāskarau
english: In dread darkness the gods and the Dānavas fought together; there Svarbhānu pierced both Soma and the Sun with his shafts.

sanskrit: atha te tamasā grastā nihanyante sma dānavaiḥ devā nṛpatiśārdūla sahaiva balibhis tadā
english: Then, seized by darkness, the gods were being slain by the Dānavas, O tiger among kings, together with the mighty ones at that time.

sanskrit: asurair vadhyamānās te kṣīṇaprāṇā divaukasaḥ apaśyanta tapasyantam atriṃ vipraṃ mahāvane
english: Slaughtered by the Asuras, their vital force ebbing away, the dwellers of heaven beheld the brahmin Atri practising austerities in the great forest.

sanskrit: athainam abruvan devāḥ śāntakrodhaṃ jitendriyam asurair iṣubhir viddhau candrādityāv imāv ubhau
english: Then the gods said to him, whose anger was stilled and whose senses were mastered: These two, the Moon and the Sun, have been pierced by the arrows of the Asuras.

sanskrit: vayaṃ vadhyāmahe cāpi śatrubhis tamasāvṛte nādhigacchāma śāntiṃ ca bhayāt trāyasva naḥ prabho
english: And we too are being slain by our foes in the enveloping darkness, and we find no peace; deliver us from our fear, O lord.

sanskrit: kathaṃ rakṣāmi bhavatas te 'bruvaṃś candramā bhava timiraghnaś ca savitā dasyuhā caiva no bhava
english: "How shall I protect you?" he asked. They said: "Become the Moon, and be for us the Sun that dispels darkness and the slayer of our robber-foes."

sanskrit: evam uktas tadātris tu tamonud abhavac chaśī apaśyat saumyabhāvaṃ ca sūryasya pratidarśanam
english: Thus addressed, Atri then became the Moon that drives away darkness, and he beheld the gentle aspect and the reappearing of the Sun's light.

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvā nātiprabhaṃ somaṃ tathā sūryaṃ ca pārthiva prakāśam akarod atris tapasā svena saṃyuge
english: Seeing the Moon dim in lustre and likewise the Sun, O king, Atri by his own austerity made light in the battle.

sanskrit: jagad vitimiraṃ cāpi pradīptam akarot tadā vyajayac chatrusaṃghāṃś ca devānāṃ svena tejasā
english: He made the world free of darkness and ablaze with light, and by his own radiant power he vanquished the hosts of the gods' enemies.

sanskrit: atriṇā dahyamānāṃs tān dṛṣṭvā devā mahāsurān parākramais te 'pi tadā vyatyaghnann atrirakṣitāḥ
english: Seeing those great Asuras burning under Atri's power, the gods too, protected by Atri, slew them in turn by their valour.

sanskrit: udbhāsitaś ca savitā devās trātā hatāsurāḥ atriṇā tv atha somatvaṃ kṛtam uttamatejasā
english: The Sun was made to shine forth, the gods were rescued, and the Asuras slain; and the office of the Moon was assumed by Atri of supreme radiance.

sanskrit: advitīyena muninā japatā carmavāsasā phalabhakṣeṇa rājarṣe paśya karmātriṇā kṛtam
english: By the peerless sage, murmuring his prayers, clad in deerskin, living on fruit—behold, O royal sage, the deed done by Atri.

sanskrit: tasyāpi vistareṇoktaṃ karmātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ bravīmy ahaṃ brūhi vā tvam atritaḥ kṣatriyaṃ varam
english: The deed of that exceedingly great-souled Atri too has been told you in full. I say to you—or do you name a Kṣatriya superior to Atri.

sanskrit: ity uktas tv arjunas tūṣṇīm abhūd vāyus tam abravīt śṛṇu rājan mahat karma cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ
english: Thus addressed, Arjuna fell silent, and the Wind said to him: Hear, O king, the great deed of the great-souled Cyavana.

sanskrit: aśvinoḥ pratisaṃśrutya cyavanaḥ pākaśāsanam provāca sahitaṃ devaiḥ somapāv aśvinau kuru
english: Having made a promise to the Aśvins, Cyavana said to the Chastiser of Pāka, in company with the gods: "Make the two Aśvins drinkers of Soma."

sanskrit: indra uvāca asmābhir varjitāv etau bhavetāṃ somapau katham devair na saṃmitāv etau tasmān maivaṃ vadasva naḥ
english: Indra said: These two, excluded by us, how should they become drinkers of Soma? They are not reckoned the equals of the gods; therefore speak not thus to us.

sanskrit: aśvibhyāṃ saha necchāmaḥ pātuṃ somaṃ mahāvrata pibantv anye yathākāmaṃ nāhaṃ pātum ihotsahe
english: We do not wish to drink Soma together with the Aśvins, O great in vows. Let others drink at will; I cannot bring myself to drink here with them.

sanskrit: cyavana uvāca na cet kariṣyasi vaco mayoktaṃ balasūdana mayā pramathitaḥ sadyaḥ somaṃ pāsyasi vai makhe
english: Cyavana said: If you will not do as I have bidden, O slayer of Bala, then, overpowered by me, you shall this very moment drink Soma at the sacrifice.

sanskrit: tataḥ karma samārabdhaṃ hitāya sahasāśvinoḥ cyavanena tato mantrair abhibhūtāḥ surābhavan
english: Then the rite was begun at once for the benefit of the Aśvins; and thereupon the gods were overpowered by Cyavana through his sacred spells.

sanskrit: tat tu karma samārabdhaṃ dṛṣṭvendraḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ udyamya vipulaṃ śailaṃ cyavanaṃ samupādravat tathā vajreṇa bhagavān amarṣākulalocanaḥ
english: But when Indra saw that rite begun, faint with wrath, lifting up a vast mountain, the lord rushed upon Cyavana, his eyes troubled with fury, the thunderbolt also in hand.

sanskrit: tam āpatantaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva cyavanas tapasānvitaḥ adbhiḥ siktvāstambhayat taṃ savajraṃ sahaparvatam
english: Seeing him swooping down, Cyavana, endowed with the power of austerity, sprinkled him with water and paralysed him, thunderbolt, mountain, and all.

sanskrit: athendrasya mahāghoraṃ so 'sṛjac chatrum eva ha madaṃ mantrāhutimayaṃ vyāditāsyaṃ mahāmuniḥ
english: Then the great sage created for Indra a most terrible foe, Mada, born of spells and oblations, his maw gaping wide.

sanskrit: tasya dantasahasraṃ tu babhūva śatayojanam dviyojanaśatās tasya daṃṣṭrāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ hanus tasyābhavad bhūmāv ekaś cāsyāspṛśad divam
english: His thousand teeth were a hundred yojanas long, his fangs, most fearsome, two hundred yojanas; one jaw of his rested upon the earth and one touched the heavens.

sanskrit: jihvāmūle sthitās tasya sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ timer āsyam anuprāptā yathā matsyā mahārṇave
english: All the gods, with Vāsava, stood at the root of his tongue, fallen into his mouth as fish into the maw of a great whale in the vast ocean.

sanskrit: te saṃmantrya tato devā madasyāsyagatās tadā abruvan sahitāḥ śakraṃ praṇamāsmai dvijātaye aśvibhyāṃ saha somaṃ ca pibāmo vigatajvarāḥ
english: Then the gods, gone into the mouth of Mada, took counsel together and said to Śakra: "Bow down to this twice-born one, and freed of our distress let us drink Soma together with the Aśvins."

sanskrit: tataḥ sa praṇataḥ śakraś cakāra cyavanasya tat cyavanaḥ kṛtavāṃs tau cāpy aśvinau somapīthinau
english: Then Śakra, bowing low, did as Cyavana wished, and Cyavana made the two Aśvins drinkers of Soma.

sanskrit: tataḥ pratyāharat karma madaṃ ca vyabhajan muniḥ akṣeṣu mṛgayāyāṃ ca pāne strīṣu ca vīryavān
english: Then the mighty sage withdrew his rite and distributed Mada among dice, hunting, drink, and women.

sanskrit: etair doṣair naro rājan kṣayaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ tasmād etān naro nityaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet
english: By these vices a man comes to ruin, O king—of this there is no doubt; therefore a man should ever keep them far from himself.

sanskrit: etat te cyavanasyāpi karma rājan prakīrtitam bravīmy ahaṃ brūhi vā tvaṃ cyavanāt kṣatriyaṃ varam
english: This deed of Cyavana too has been proclaimed to you, O king. I say to you—or do you name a Kṣatriya superior to Cyavana.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca tūṣṇīm āsīd arjunas tu pavanas tv abravīt punaḥ śṛṇu me brāhmaṇeṣv eva mukhyaṃ karma janādhipa
english: Bhīṣma said: Arjuna remained silent, and the Wind spoke again: Hear from me, O lord of men, a foremost deed among the brahmins.

sanskrit: madasyāsyam anuprāptā yadā sendrā divaukasaḥ tadeyaṃ cyavaneneha hṛtā teṣāṃ vasuṃdharā
english: When the dwellers of heaven, with Indra, had fallen into the mouth of Mada, then their earth was here seized away by Cyavana.

sanskrit: ubhau lokau hṛtau matvā te devā duḥkhitābhavan śokārtāś ca mahātmānaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
english: Deeming both worlds taken from them, the gods grew sorrowful, and afflicted with grief they went for refuge to the great-souled Brahmā.

sanskrit: devā ūcuḥ madāsyavyatiṣiktānām asmākaṃ lokapūjita cyavanena hṛtā bhūmiḥ kapaiś cāpi divaṃ prabho
english: The gods said: O you whom the worlds revere, from us who were cast into the mouth of Mada the earth has been seized by Cyavana, and heaven too by the Kapas, O lord.

sanskrit: brahmovāca gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ viprān āśu sendrā divaukasaḥ prasādya tān ubhau lokāv avāpsyatha yathā purā
english: Brahmā said: Go quickly for refuge to the brahmins, O dwellers of heaven with Indra; by winning their grace you shall regain both worlds as before.

sanskrit: te yayuḥ śaraṇaṃ viprāṃs ta ūcuḥ kāñ jayāmahe ity uktās te dvijān prāhur jayateha kapān iti bhūgatān hi vijetāro vayam ity eva pārthiva
english: They went for refuge to the brahmins, who asked: "Whom shall we conquer?" Thus addressed, they said to the twice-born: "Conquer here the Kapas"—for, O son of Pṛthā, the brahmins said, "We shall be the conquerors of those who dwell upon the earth."

sanskrit: tataḥ karma samārabdhaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ kapanāśanam tac chrutvā preṣito dūto brāhmaṇebhyo dhanī kapaiḥ
english: Then a rite for the destruction of the Kapas was begun by the brahmins; hearing of it, the Kapas sent Dhanin as their envoy to the brahmins.

sanskrit: sa ca tān brāhmaṇān āha dhanī kapavaco yathā bhavadbhiḥ sadṛśāḥ sarve kapāḥ kim iha vartate
english: And Dhanin said to those brahmins, as the Kapas had bidden: "All the Kapas are the equals of yourselves; what then is afoot here?

sanskrit: sarve vedavidaḥ prājñāḥ sarve ca kratuyājinaḥ sarve satyavratāś caiva sarve tulyā maharṣibhiḥ
english: All are knowers of the Veda and wise; all are performers of sacrifices; all are vowed to truth; all are the equals of the great sages.

sanskrit: śrīś caiva ramate teṣu dhārayanti śriyaṃ ca te vṛthā dārān na gacchanti vṛthāmāṃsaṃ na bhuñjate
english: Prosperity delights in them and they uphold prosperity; they do not approach wives in vain, nor do they eat flesh in vain.

sanskrit: dīptam agniṃ juhvati ca gurūṇāṃ vacane sthitāḥ sarve ca niyatātmāno bālānāṃ saṃvibhāginaḥ
english: They make oblation to the blazing fire and abide by the word of their elders; all are self-controlled and share their portion with children.

sanskrit: upetya śakaṭair yānti na sevanti rajasvalām abhuktavatsu nāśnanti divā caiva na śerate
english: They travel by approaching with carts, they do not consort with a woman in her courses, they do not eat while others remain unfed, and by day they do not sleep.

sanskrit: etaiś cānyaiś ca bahubhir guṇair yuktān kathaṃ kapān vijeṣyatha nivartadhvaṃ nivṛttānāṃ śubhaṃ hi vaḥ
english: How then will you conquer the Kapas, endowed with these and many other virtues? Turn back; for those who desist, all shall be well."

sanskrit: brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ kapān vayaṃ vijeṣyāmo ye devās te vayaṃ smṛtāḥ tasmād vadhyāḥ kapāsmākaṃ dhanin yāhi yathāgatam
english: The brahmins said: We shall conquer the Kapas; they who are the gods, those are reckoned to be we ourselves. Therefore the Kapas are to be slain by us; go, Dhanin, the way you came.

sanskrit: dhanī gatvā kapān āha na vo viprāḥ priyaṃkarāḥ gṛhītvāstrāṇy atho viprān kapāḥ sarve samādravan
english: Dhanin went and told the Kapas: "The brahmins mean you no kindness." Then, taking up their weapons, all the Kapas charged upon the brahmins.

sanskrit: samudagradhvajān dṛṣṭvā kapān sarve dvijātayaḥ vyasṛjañ jvalitān agnīn kapānāṃ prāṇanāśanān
english: Seeing the Kapas with their banners raised high, all the twice-born loosed blazing fires that destroyed the lives of the Kapas.

sanskrit: brahmasṛṣṭā havyabhujaḥ kapān bhuktvā sanātanāḥ nabhasīva yathābhrāṇi vyarājanta narādhipa praśaśaṃsur dvijāṃś caiva brahmāṇaṃ ca yaśasvinam
english: The eternal fire-gods, created by Brahmā, eaters of oblations, having devoured the Kapas, shone like clouds in the sky, O lord of men, and praised the twice-born and the illustrious Brahmā.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ tejas tathā vīryaṃ devānāṃ vavṛdhe tataḥ avāpnuvaṃś cāmaratvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pūjitam
english: Then the radiance and might of those gods waxed great, and they attained immortality, honoured throughout the three worlds.

sanskrit: ity uktavacanaṃ vāyum arjunaḥ pratyabhāṣata pratipūjya mahābāho yat tac chṛṇu narādhipa
english: To the Wind who had spoken thus Arjuna replied, having paid him honour; hear, O mighty-armed lord of men, what he said.

sanskrit: jīvāmy ahaṃ brāhmaṇārthe sarvathā satataṃ prabho brahmaṇe brāhmaṇebhyaś ca praṇamāmi ca nityaśaḥ
english: I live always and in every way for the sake of the brahmins, O lord; to Brahman and to the brahmins I bow down perpetually.

sanskrit: dattātreyaprasādāc ca mayā prāptam idaṃ yaśaḥ loke ca paramā kīrtir dharmaś ca carito mahān
english: And by the grace of Dattātreya this glory was won by me, and supreme renown in the world, and great dharma practised.

sanskrit: aho brāhmaṇakarmāṇi yathā māruta tattvataḥ tvayā proktāni kārtsnyena śrutāni prayatena ha
english: Ah, O Wind, the deeds of the brahmins, just as they truly are, told by you in full, have been heard by me with diligent care.

sanskrit: vāyur uvāca brāhmaṇān kṣatradharmeṇa pālayasvendriyāṇi ca bhṛgubhyas te bhayaṃ ghoraṃ tat tu kālād bhaviṣyati
english: The Wind said: Protect the brahmins by the law of the Kṣatriya, and protect your senses; a dread peril to you shall come from the Bhṛgus, but that shall arise in due time.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca brāhmaṇān arcase rājan satataṃ saṃśitavratān kaṃ tu karmodayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tān arcasi narādhipa
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: You ever honour the brahmins of firm vows, O king; but seeing what fruit of their deeds do you honour them, O lord of men?

sanskrit: kāṃ vā brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāvrata tān arcasi mahābāho sarvam etad vadasva me
english: Or what reward in the worship of brahmins have you seen, O great in vows, that you honour them, O mighty-armed one? Tell me all this.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca eṣa te keśavaḥ sarvam ākhyāsyati mahāmatiḥ vyuṣṭiṃ brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ dṛṣṭavyuṣṭir mahāvrataḥ
english: Bhīṣma said: This Keśava of great wisdom will declare it all to you—the reward in the worship of brahmins, he of great vows who has himself seen its fruit.

sanskrit: balaṃ śrotre vāṅ manaś cakṣuṣī ca; jñānaṃ tathā na viśuddhaṃ mamādya dehanyāso nāticirān mato me; na cātitūrṇaṃ savitādya yāti
english: My strength, my hearing, my speech, my mind, my eyes, and my knowledge are no longer clear in me this day; the laying down of my body is, I think, not far off, and yet the Sun does not pass too swiftly today.

sanskrit: uktā dharmā ye purāṇe mahānto; brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ ca paurāṇaṃ ye daṇḍam upāsate ca; śeṣaṃ kṛṣṇād upaśikṣasva pārtha
english: The great duties that are told in ancient lore, of brahmins, of Kṣatriyas, and of Vaiśyas, and the ancient rule of governance which men observe—the rest learn from Kṛṣṇa, O son of Pṛthā.

sanskrit: ahaṃ hy enaṃ vedmi tattvena kṛṣṇaṃ; yo 'yaṃ hi yac cāsya balaṃ purāṇam ameyātmā keśavaḥ kauravendra; so 'yaṃ dharmaṃ vakṣyati saṃśayeṣu
english: For I know this Kṛṣṇa in truth—who he is and what his ancient might is; Keśava of immeasurable spirit, O lord of the Kurus, he it is who will declare dharma where doubts arise.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇaḥ pṛthvīm asṛjat khaṃ divaṃ ca; varāho 'yaṃ bhīmabalaḥ purāṇaḥ asya cādho 'thāntarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca; diśaś catasraḥ pradiśaś catasraḥ sṛṣṭis tathaiveyam anuprasūtā; sa nirmame viśvam idaṃ purāṇam
english: Kṛṣṇa created the earth, the sky, and the heavens; this is the ancient Boar of dreadful strength. From him came the lower region, the firmament, and heaven, the four quarters and the four intermediate quarters; this creation too was brought forth from him—he it was who fashioned this ancient universe.

sanskrit: asya nābhyāṃ puṣkaraṃ saṃprasūtaṃ; yatrotpannaḥ svayam evāmitaujāḥ yenācchinnaṃ tat tamaḥ pārtha ghoraṃ; yat tat tiṣṭhaty arṇavaṃ tarjayānam
english: From his navel sprang the lotus, wherein arose, of himself, the one of boundless power, by whom that dread darkness was cleft, O son of Pṛthā, the darkness that abides menacing over the ocean.

sanskrit: kṛte yuge dharma āsīt samagras; tretākāle jñānam anuprapannaḥ balaṃ tv āsīd dvāpare pārtha kṛṣṇaḥ; kalāv adharmaḥ kṣitim ājagāma
english: In the Kṛta age dharma was entire; in the Tretā age knowledge took its course; strength prevailed in the Dvāpara, O son of Pṛthā—Kṛṣṇa; and in the Kali age unrighteousness came upon the earth.

sanskrit: sa pūrvadevo nijaghāna daityān; sa pūrvadevaś ca babhūva samrāṭ sa bhūtānāṃ bhāvano bhūtabhavyaḥ; sa viśvasyāsya jagataś cāpi goptā
english: He, the primeval god, slew the Daityas; he, the primeval god, became sovereign; he is the nourisher of beings, who has been and shall be; and he is the protector of all this universe.

sanskrit: yadā dharmo glāyati vai surāṇāṃ; tadā kṛṣṇo jāyate mānuṣeṣu dharme sthitvā sa tu vai bhāvitātmā; parāṃś ca lokān aparāṃś ca yāti
english: When the dharma of the gods grows faint, then Kṛṣṇa is born among men; and he, of disciplined spirit, abiding in dharma, passes to the higher worlds and the lower.

sanskrit: tyājyāṃs tyaktvāthāsurāṇāṃ vadhāya; kāryākārye kāraṇaṃ caiva pārtha kṛtaṃ kariṣyat kriyate ca devo; muhuḥ somaṃ viddhi ca śakram etam
english: Forsaking what is to be forsaken, for the slaying of the Asuras, he is the cause of what should and should not be done, O son of Pṛthā; the god is what has been done, what shall be done, and what is being done; know him too to be again and again Soma and Śakra.

sanskrit: sa viśvakarmā sa ca viśvarūpaḥ; sa viśvabhṛd viśvasṛg viśvajic ca sa śūlabhṛc choṇitabhṛt karālas; taṃ karmabhir viditaṃ vai stuvanti
english: He is the maker of all, and he is the all-formed; he is the upholder of all, the creator of all, and the conqueror of all; he is the bearer of the trident, the bearer of blood, the terrible one; him, known by his deeds, they praise.

sanskrit: taṃ gandharvā apsarasaś ca nityam; upatiṣṭhante vibudhānāṃ śatāni taṃ rākṣasāś ca parisaṃvahante; rāyaspoṣaḥ sa vijigīṣur ekaḥ
english: Him the Gandharvas and the Apsarases attend continually, and hundreds of the wise gods; the Rākṣasas too bear him about; he alone is the increase of wealth and the seeker of conquest.

sanskrit: tam adhvare śaṃsitāraḥ stuvanti; rathaṃtare sāmagāś ca stuvanti taṃ brāhmaṇā brahmamantraiḥ stuvanti; tasmai havir adhvaryavaḥ kalpayanti
english: Him the reciters praise at the sacrifice, and the singers of the Sāman praise him in the Rathantara; the brahmins praise him with the spells of Brahman, and for him the Adhvaryus prepare the oblation.

sanskrit: sa paurāṇīṃ brahmaguhāṃ praviṣṭo; mahīsatraṃ bhāratāgre dadarśa sa caiva gām uddadhārāgryakarmā; vikṣobhya daityān uragān dānavāṃś ca
english: Having entered the ancient cave of Brahman, he beheld at the dawn of the Bhārata age the great sacrificial session of the earth; and he, of foremost deeds, lifted up the earth, having confounded the Daityas, the serpents, and the Dānavas.

sanskrit: tasya bhakṣān vividhān vedayanti; tam evājau vāhanaṃ vedayanti tasyāntarikṣaṃ pṛthivī divaṃ ca; sarvaṃ vaśe tiṣṭhati śāśvatasya
english: They declare his many foods; him alone they declare to be the conveyance in battle; the firmament, the earth, and heaven—all stands in the power of the eternal one.

sanskrit: sa kumbharetāḥ sasṛje purāṇaṃ; yatrotpannam ṛṣim āhur vasiṣṭham sa mātariśvā vibhur aśvavājī; sa raśmimān savitā cādidevaḥ
english: He, whose seed was held in the pot, created in ancient time that wherein, they say, was born the sage Vasiṣṭha; he is Mātariśvan, the all-pervading, swift as a steed; he is the radiant Sun, the primeval god.

sanskrit: tenāsurā vijitāḥ sarva eva; tasya vikrāntair vijitānīha trīṇi sa devānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ; tam evāhur yajñavidāṃ vitānam
english: By him all the Asuras were vanquished; by his strides the three worlds here were won; the worlds of the gods, of men, and of the fathers—him alone the knowers of sacrifice call the spreading of the sacrificial fires.

sanskrit: sa eva kālaṃ vibhajann udeti; tasyottaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cāyane dve tasyaivordhvaṃ tiryag adhaś caranti; gabhastayo medinīṃ tāpayantaḥ
english: He it is who rises, apportioning time; his are the two courses, the northern and the southern; his are the rays that move upward, sideways, and downward, scorching the earth.
